cards.text: GALLAGHER: I don’t know bout Nelsonville. SERRADAS: I’ actually spoke to Chairman Tamagna earlier. He said he’d spoke… has a very good relationship, if you will… with Supervisor Pagones. One of the things they’ve been working on is having a good relationship… having a good face to face meeting. One of things they talked about to alleviate the possibility of doing this is reducing it from a regular community where we have children to a 55 plus community. If it is a 55 plus, it’s less likely a chance we would be directly impacted. The thought is we should be conservative in approaching it from a legal perspective. At least in my mind. Let’s see that plan out. Let’s see that work itself through. Last resort being on the legal. I think it is important to start that and I think Haldane has already started that when I spoke to Dr. Valenti. I just think we need to be prudent in what we do. Mind you I do a lot of work with the Haldane school district, so I am pretty aware of what it costs to put a kid through school. GALLAGHER: They’re also… and they’re looking for a show of support also. So… and anything that does get it changed up there… you know…is probably due…is probably going to be due to the activities…you know… the village… just to tell people generally…to tell people up at Fishkill…the school district itself. So we can talk about further…I’m going to meet with them on Friday too. We can talk about the actual commitment of money next week. GALLAGHER READS RESOLUTION. Gallagher changing estimate in resolution: “up to 140 students.” GALLAGHER: Questions? Comments? SERRADAS: At some time we’ll discuss the specific dollar amount, at the bottom it says, “Will support efforts” I just…Not to be rude; I’m just trying to understand why we need a resolution. Why can’t we just send them a letter of explaining our support? We’re spending village money to create a resolution. GALLAGHER: We’re not. How are we spending any money? SERRADAS: You said you asked Gaba to write up a resolution. GALLAGHER: No, I wrote this. SERRADAS: Ok. GALLAGHER: The one on…He’s writing….he wrote the one on the two thousand dollars. SERRADAS: Ok. I think we should table it. Whatever. Discuss the dollar amount at another point. GALLAGHER: This is just on supporting…just saying that we support the effort. There’s no dollar amount attached to it. It doesn’t say we’re committed to any money or anything. This is really just to say we’re behind the effort. CAMPBELL: Also along with everyone else…they’re doing something similar…something similar to this. They’ve asked everyone to join in this. GALLAGHER: Yes. Yes.
